name: Adaptive Model
description: Makes a selectable "adaptive" model pick a configured model for each user message, classified by a local model through the LiteLLM router.

adaptiveModel.description: Model ref that turns adaptive routing on when it is the selected model (default litellm-router/adaptive). Any other selected model is used as-is.

defaultModel.description: Model ref for COMPLEX requests and the anchor for the other tiers. Default: the first non-local fallback of the agent's model selection.

tiers.description: Pin the model ref used for a tier. Unset tiers are chosen from the configured models automatically.

candidates.description: Explicit list of model refs to route between. Default: every configured model (primary, fallbacks, model picker entries and custom provider models).

exclude.description: Model refs or provider ids never routed to.

routerBaseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL of the LiteLLM router (default http://127.0.0.1:18791/v1).

routerKeyFile.description: File holding the router's API key (default <state dir>/litellm/master.key).

classifierModel.description: Router model name of the local classifier (default local-classifier).

timeoutMs.description: Budget for one classification (default 5000). On timeout the previous choice of the conversation is kept, else the adaptive model's own router answers.

stickyMinutes.description: How long a conversation remembers its last choice (default 30).

shortFollowUpChars.description: Messages up to this length never downgrade the conversation's current model (default 80).

recentTurns.description: Earlier user messages given to the classifier as context (default 3).

leanLocalPrompt.description: When a message is routed to the local model, send it a short chat-only system prompt without tools instead of the full agent prompt (default true). A small local model cannot act on the full agent prompt, and reading it takes many seconds.
